$comment: Published geometry allowance per shell. Triangles and bytes are the welded runtime packing: one primitive per material slot plus the nodes a consumer addresses by name.

facadeRate.$comment: Triangles per square metre of facade (ground outline perimeter times total height). A long or tall shell is allowed its area at this rate when that is more than the ordinary allowance.

tower.$comment: Nine floors at the 4.5 m default pitch clears 40 m.

architectures.$comment: An authored composition may cost more than a plain facade by design. The multiple applies to the allowance the shell would otherwise get; absent means 1.

premiumRoofTerrace.$comment: Additive allowance for the furnished rich/high-rich balcony-grid roof when roof artifacts are enabled: explicit fern clumps, fine wire furniture and fitted outdoor rooms. Measured separately from the facade multiplier; ordinary/off roofs retain their original budgets.
